reference_sources.origin: Hugging Face Xing4.0-29B-A4B repository files (model card license apache-2.0), fetched 2026-09-18; used as the numerical reference, not copied

mined_symbols: Model.sanitize expert stacking and kv_b_proj folding
modifications: Replaced the single residual with hc_mult mHC streams per the HF reference: fp32 unweighted RMSNorm + hc_fn projection, sigmoid pre, 2*sigmoid post, clamp(+-30) comb logits, 20 Sinkhorn row-then-column iterations with eps 1e-6, comb @ H in HF orientation (no vLLM transpose, no hc_pre_eps)
Added an mx.compile(shapeless) mHC coefficient/collapse span and stream-update span with an uncompiled reference path, fail-closed demotion and call counters
Router follows HF Xing4_0TopkRouter: fp32 logits, no group-limited selection, /(sum+1e-20) normalisation even at top_k=1
MoE iff layer_idx >= first_k_dense_replace (HF ignores moe_layer_freq)
Attention calls mx.fast SDPA directly so a cache bucketed-attention hook cannot read the rope keys as values; quantized latent caches refused (unqualified)
RoPE traditional flag follows rope_interleave; YaRN via mlx2 rope_utils with legacy rope_scaling type key
Added a DeepSeek-V3 MTP head (checkpoint layer num_hidden_layers) with mlx2's native self-MTP interface; MTP embed/head copies are dropped only when proven bit-equal to the trunk tensors
Removed fp8/int4 compressed-tensor dequantisation (refused), FarSkip, gated attention, pipeline and sharding
Standard mlx2 KVCache per layer holding the MLA latent; no model-specific cache class

validation.stage: CPU only; real weights not loaded; no GPU use
validation.fixture: tests/fixtures/xing4_0_tiny from scripts/xing4_0_reference_fixture.py under torch 2.12.1 / transformers 5.12.1, fp32 eager, tiny config (hidden 64, 4 layers = 2 dense + 2 MoE, 8 experts top-2, hc_mult 4, vocab 128, real YaRN rope parameters)
validation.result: 22 passed; full-sequence logits max abs error ~3e-6 vs HF fp32; MTP logits ~1.5e-6 vs DeepSeek-MTP reference built from HF blocks
coverage: full-sequence logits and post-norm hidden vs HF
standalone mHC vs HF; compiled vs reference mHC and stream update
left-padded BatchKVCache prefill+decode, merged caches with right-padded ragged verify and ragged trim
MTP step parity, incremental, batched right-padded, trim
greedy batched self-MTP through hybrid_speculative equals plain greedy decode
sanitize idempotence, MTP dedupe/keep branches, MTP disabled/absent
quant/cast predicates keep hc_* and router full precision
validation.qualification: No route selected; real-artifact load, GPU parity and serving qualification outstanding
